svg.title: Correct oscillator energies do not remove turning-point failure
svg.desc: Harmonic oscillator with eta=x/ell_ho, ell_ho=sqrt(hbar/(m omega)), E=(n+1/2) hbar omega. Curves use exact Hermite states and interior leading WKB at 0.99 of each turning coordinate; endpoints themselves are excluded. WKB diverges at turning points; exact states remain finite.

g.text: Correct oscillator energies do not remove turning-point failure
